Q880065.label: Jorge Luis Felipe
Q880065.summary: Héctor Rafael García-Godoy Cáceres was a Dominican politician who served as the 44th president of the Dominican Republic from 1965 to 1966. He led the transitional government which ruled the country following the Dominican Civil War and organized elections held the following year. Former president Joaquín Balaguer won the election and succeeded García-Godoy which marked the beginning of Balaguer's 12 year rule, simply known as "The Twelve Years".

Q4181441.label: Slovak early parliamentary elections referendum
Q4181441.summary: A referendum on holding early parliamentary elections was held in Slovakia on 11 November 2000. Although approved by 95.1% of those voting, voter turnout was just 20% and the referendum was declared invalid due to insufficient turnout.

Q751553.label: June 2012 Greek legislative election
Q751553.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on Sunday, 17 June 2012, to elect all 300 members to the Hellenic Parliament in accordance with the constitution, after all attempts to form a new government failed following the May elections.

Q3089345.label: Laimdota Straujuma
Q3089345.summary: Laimdota Straujuma is a Latvian economist who was the prime minister of Latvia from January 2014 to February 2016. Before her tenure as prime minister, she served as the minister of Agriculture from 2011 to 2014. She was the first woman to serve as the head of government of the country.

Q61122497.label: 2019 Latvian presidential election
Q61122497.summary: Indirect presidential elections were held in Latvia on 29 May 2019.

Q4372929.label: 1995 Pakistani coup d'état attempt
Q4372929.desc: 1995 attempted military takeover of government in Pakistan
Q4372929.summary: The Pakistan coup attempt of 1995 was a secretive Coup d'état plot hatched by renegade officers of Pakistan Army and Islamists against the government of Benazir Bhutto, the prime minister of Pakistan.

Q29213121.label: 2017 Stockholm attack
Q29213121.desc: terrorist attack in Stockholm, Sweden on 7 April 2017
Q29213121.summary: On 7 April 2017, a vehicle-ramming terrorist attack took place in central Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. A hijacked truck was deliberately driven into crowds along Drottninggatan before being crashed into an Åhléns department store. Five people were killed and 14 others were seriously injured.

Q113503169.label: stabbing of Salman Rushdie
Q113503169.desc: 2022 attack in Chautauqua, New York, US
Q113503169.summary: On August 12, 2022, Indian-born British-American novelist Salman Rushdie was stabbed multiple times by 24-year-old Hadi Matar as he was about to give a public lecture at the Chautauqua Institution in Chautauqua, New York, United States. Matar was immediately arrested and charged the following day with assault and attempted murder.

Q6273473.label: Jonathan Jackson
Q6273473.summary: Jonathan Luther Jackson is an American activist and politician serving as the U.S. representative for Illinois's 1st congressional district since 2023. A member of the Democratic Party and son of Rev. Jesse Jackson, he was previously the national spokesman for the Rainbow/PUSH Coalition, a financial analyst, and a partner in the beer distributorship River North Sales and Service, based in Chicago.
